page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Two coin medallions (engravings) side by side, left and right, with their legends in the circles. Below them one column of running text, full width. Gathering signature at lower right, below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: AVREL. Alexander Seuerus,ab Heliogabalo adoptatus, post eum imperauit anno mundi 4185. à natiui. Christi 223. à prima pueritia bonis artibus imbutus,pius,mãsuetus & liberalis extitit:Christianis fauit:vetuit ne mulieres vulgato corpore matrem illius Mammeã salutarent.in pretio habuit Vlpianum, & tãquam tutorem. bonorum principũ vitam versibus descripsit.Fures valde perfecutus est,quos inimicos reipu.dictitabat. cum solus accumberet, librũ ad mensam habebat:quãdo conuiuas habebat,aderat Vlpianus atq; aliquot alij,quorum doctis sermonibus ac disceptationibus recreabatur inter epulas. aduersus Parthos , quos vicit,exercitũ duxit,habès milites tantæ grauitatis & modestiæ,vt quacũque iter faceret,Senatores esse dicerentur,non milites. Ad Alexandri magni mores sefe coponebat,cũ eiusdem nominis esset,imò & exuperare satagebat, inquiens multum interesse debere inter Romanum [?]Alexandrum, & Macedonem.clamabat sæpe,atq; per præconẽ proclamari iubebat, cũm aliquẽ emendaret, Quod tibi fieri non vis, alteri ne feceris. Tandem factione militari vnà cum matre in tentorio necatur.vixit annos 29.imperauit 13.ÆI.Lampri.& Herodi.li.6.

MAMMEA, mater Alexandri Seueri,à quibusdam dicitur Christiana fuisse,& ab Origene edocta. hæc filiũ eò coegerat,vt quæ mensæ superessent edulia,quãuis permodica,altera vice apponerentur.Aurel. Vict.Ab.Vrsper.Eufe.li.6.cap.16.

page.notes: The two medallions are engraved portraits; their legends are transcribed above as lines. Doubtful: the mark before "Alexandrum" in the first paragraph (shown as a curved stroke) is marked [?]. The first words of both paragraphs are set in spaced capitals; the first was set in italic-like spacing and is given in italics as headword. The line "Quod tibi fieri non vis" is underlined in print; underline not reproduced.
